description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithEmployeeName' that implements a value formatting strategy by retrieving an employee's full name based on an employee number. It utilizes traits and interfaces from the OrangeHRM system to fetch and format employee data.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeName
classes.description: A class that formats entity values by replacing employee numbers with full employee names using HRM system services.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the full name of an employee given their employee number, returning null if not found.
